title: Strobogrammatic Number II
statement:
Given an integer n, return all the strobogrammatic numbers that are of length n. Return the strings in ascending lexicographic order.
A strobogrammatic number is a number that looks the same when rotated 180 degrees (looked at upside down).

## Examples

### Example 1

```text
Input: n = 2
Output: ["11","69","88","96"]
```

### Example 2

```text
Input: n = 1
Output: ["0","1","8"]
```

## Constraints

- 1 <= n <= 14
